description: Develop a puzzle game where the player must group 16 words into four sets of four, based on hidden categories. The words are presented in a 4x4 grid, and players select four at a time to form a group. Correct groups are removed and revealed with a category and a color-coded difficulty (yellow, green, blue, purple). Incorrect guesses count as mistakes, with a maximum of four allowed. Only one correct solution exists, though words may appear to fit multiple categories. Include shuffle functionality and provide immediate feedback after each guess. A new puzzle is generated daily.
